preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 30 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 3 * 10**4 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the permutation n is between 1 and 30,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c <= 4 for c in [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.split()[1].isdigit()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the maximum cost c is between 1 and 4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= q <= 3 * 10**5 for q in [int(line.split()[2]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.split()[2].isdigit()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of queries q is between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(p) == n for p in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) == n])
preconditions.description: The permutation p has exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p) for p in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) == n])
preconditions.description: Each element p_i in the permutation is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(p)) == n for p in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) == n])
preconditions.description: The permutation p contains all integers from 1 to n exactly once.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n for i in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit() and 'query' in line.lower()])
preconditions.description: For each query, the index i is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= j <= 10**18 for j in [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.split()[1].isdigit() and 'query' in line.lower()])
preconditions.description: For each query, the permutation index j is between 1 and 10^18 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout_lines) == sum(q for _, _, q in test_cases) for stdout_lines in [stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the total number of queries across all test cases.

postconditions.expression: all((1 <= int(line) <= n or int(line) == -1) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip())
postconditions.description: Each output line is either a valid element from the permutation (1 to n) or -1 if the permutation does not exist.

postconditions.expression: all((j <= len(permutations) or answer == -1) for (i, j), answer, permutations in zip(queries, stdout_lines, test_case_permutations))
postconditions.description: For each query (i, j), if j exceeds the number of permutations, the answer is -1; otherwise, the answer is the i-th element of the j-th permutation in the sorted list.

postconditions.expression: all(permutations[j-1][i-1] == int(answer) for (i, j), answer, permutations in zip(queries, stdout_lines, test_case_permutations) if answer != '-1')
postconditions.description: For each query (i, j) where the permutation exists, the answer is the i-th element of the j-th permutation in the sorted list.
